Client Engagement Details

Our client is one of the world's leading entertainment companies, representing top talent across entertainment, sports, and media on a global scale, spanning film, television, music, sports, fashion, and digital media. They're building the next generation of internal platforms that power how agents and teams manage relationships, deals, and opportunities across the global entertainment industry, making performance, availability, security, and observability mission-critical.

You'll own the infrastructure and reliability environment end-to-end, including cloud resources, Kubernetes deployments, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and infrastructure security. The company is currently migrating from a legacy platform to a modern cloud-native environment, and you'll work across both the new platform and the ongoing migration as systems transition module by module.

The engineering organization is being built largely from the ground up, a strong opportunity for someone who enjoys greenfield infrastructure work and wants to help shape how the engineering team builds and ships software.
